props.name: days
props.description: Days in the window; the last one is today.

props.name: incidents
props.description: Day indexes (0 = oldest) with degraded performance.

props.name: outages
props.description: Day indexes (0 = oldest) with an outage.

props.name: status
props.description: The current status. Defaults to today's: the last day's outage or incident, else operational.

props.name: labels
props.description: UI text; every key is optional and falls back to the English default.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the uptime and day count (default `"en-US"`).

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.

props.name: legendDegraded
props.description: Legend of the degraded and outage days.

props.name: daysAgo
props.description: Start of the window; `{count}` is replaced by the number of days.
